instruction:
Two Storey Outpatient Clinic Retrofit IFC

This task starts from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc and uses the local reference image C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_sheet.png. Modify the starting model into a two-storey outpatient clinic and save the required output in the Desktop as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc is at least 500 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities, 11 IfcSpace entities, 24 IfcWall entities, 2 IfcSlab entities, and 1 IfcStair.
5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcDoor, 0 IfcWindow, 0 IfcCurtainWall, 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, 0 IfcColumn, and 0 IfcBeam entities.
6. The normalized IfcSpace name list contains the token consultation at least 4 times, treatment at least 2 times, accessible toilet at least 2 times, waiting at least once, and staff at least once.
7. The normalized IfcSpace name list contains the exact space name exam support at least once.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.

command: if exist "C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Revit 2027\Revit.exe" (echo OK) else (echo MISSING & exit /b 1)
